author: RightSide
body:
Because the hubs are down click add server and do Mczone01.avic.us then to go on a different one just change it like this Mczone02.avic.us or luna.avic.us . Heres a list of some Nebula servers:
Mczone01.avic.us
Mczone02.avic.us
Luna.avic.us
Nebula01.avic.us
Nebula02.avic.us
Nebula03.avic.us
Cronus.avic.us
There is more...

Or when you are connected to one do /server McZone02 or what ever server you wish to go on like /server Luna . The hubs may be up soon this is for now !
